sentences.en: To be always logical may be sometimes hated by others.
sentences.zh: 总是符合逻辑可能会被别人有时讨厌。

sentences.en: Make it your law: logical thought, peaceful mind, virtuous action.
sentences.zh: 让你的原则是：合乎常理的思想，平静的心灵，高尚的行为。

sentences.en: If something doesn't make sense, it probably isn't logical.
sentences.zh: 如果某件事不合情理，那它可能不符合逻辑。

senses.zh: 合乎逻辑的，符合逻辑的；合理的，有理的；必然的，顺理成章的
